card.line: The Gate of Benjamin was a gate of Jerusalem near the house of the LORD, where Jeremiah was punished and where King Zedekiah once sat to hear a plea.

moments.title: Jeremiah put in the stocks
moments.text: Pashhur the priest heard Jeremiah prophesying. He had Jeremiah beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, by the house of the LORD.

moments.title: Jeremiah seized at the gate
moments.text: Jeremiah tried to leave Jerusalem for the land of Benjamin. At the gate, the captain of the guard accused him of deserting to the Chaldeans, and Jeremiah was arrested and put in prison.

moments.title: Ebed-melech speaks to the king
moments.text: King Zedekiah was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin when Ebed-melech told him Jeremiah had been put in a cistern. The king ordered Jeremiah pulled out before he died.

moments.title: Jerusalem raised up
moments.text: Zechariah says that on that day Jerusalem will be raised up and remain in her place. The Benjamin Gate is named as one of its marks.
